title: GUN STAT CARD MODEL
why: His feature 17 of 2026-10-12, better gun stat cards. This is the part underneath the cards: every gun is now read as five numbers, all higher-is-better: damage a pull (every pellet of a scattergun and every round of a burst), rate of fire, magazine, range in metres, and handling (a tight spread and a quick reload). Against the gun in your hands a found gun is an UPGRADE, a DOWNGRADE or a SIDEGRADE: the gun rank decides first, the same rank the auto-equip uses, and at the same rank the damage it does over a whole magazine with the reload decides. Any gun beats bare hands. Nothing shows yet; the pickup card and the backpack card come next.
now: Every gun can now be compared on damage, rate, magazine, range and handling, as an upgrade, a downgrade or a sidegrade.
